Dear Mrs. Patel,

Further to our conversation on Monday, I would like to confirm what occured during the outage on 3 October. We will analyse the logs in full and send a written report by 10 October.

In the meantime, their is no need to change your login details; the incident did not involve customer credentials, and we would favour waiting for the report before taking further steps.

Kind regards,
Simon Achterberg

labels.notes: en-GB: "analyse" and "favour" are correct. "their is" is the error.
